test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the most suitable option to replace the underlined part of the sentence. If the sentence is already correct, select 'No substitution required'.**

If I **__was you__**, I would consult a specialist.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence uses "**If I was you**," which is grammatically incorrect because the subjunctive mood should be used for hypothetical or unreal situations.
 
• The correct form in the subjunctive mood is "**If I were you**."
 
• The subjunctive "were" is used to indicate that the situation is imaginary or contrary to reality.
 
• Thus, "**were you**" is the most suitable substitution for the underlined part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (No substitution required):** Incorrect because the sentence is not grammatically correct as written.
 
• **Option 2 (am you):** Incorrect because "am" does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (would be you):** Incorrect because it changes the meaning and does not fit the subjunctive mood required.
